scripts.test: bun test --tsconfig-override test/tsconfig.json test/FastRefreshContent.test.tsx && bun test --tsconfig-override test/tsconfig.json test/*.test.ts test/ErrorWrapper.test.tsx test/ReactRefreshRuntime.test.ts test/ReactRefreshTransform.test.ts test/RouterHMR.test.tsx test/RouterHost.test.tsx test/utils.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: bash -c 'tsc --noEmit --pretty false --incremental false > /tmp/apply-react-tsc.log 2>&1 || true; if grep -v node_modules/ /tmp/apply-react-tsc.log | grep -q "error TS"; then cat /tmp/apply-react-tsc.log; exit 1; fi'
